info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Petadoption Pets Medicals-v1-spec
info.description: The Pet Medical Information Retrieval API allows users to access up-to-date medical information about pets available for adoption. This endpoint serves valuable data about pets' health records and medical histories, aiding potential adopters in making informed decisions. Typical consumers include animal shelters, adoption agencies, and prospective pet owners seeking comprehensive medical insights. By leveraging this API, stakeholders can enhance the adoption process and significantly improve the welfare of pets in need of homes.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to access medical records and information regarding pets' health and treatments. It is useful for pet owners, veterinary staff, and anyone needing detailed medical insights into their pets' wellbeing.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the medical records of pets. Ensure that the correct format is followed and any necessary filters are applied for efficient data retrieval.

200.description: Successfully retrieved medical records for pets.
